RULING_1_max_targets_v1_is_an_UNEXECUTED.the_finding: prompts/final_pairing/v1/metadata.json:251-252 pre-registers max_targets_v1 = 3 and second_target_relevance_gain_min = 1.0. VERIFIED: the only two occurrences in the entire tree -- tracked AND raw including gitignored paths -- are metadata.json itself and build_prompt_sets.py:69-70, the script that PRODUCES metadata.json. There is no runtime reader.
RULING_1_max_targets_v1_is_an_UNEXECUTED.verdict: THE PRE-REGISTRATION IS REAL AND THE CAPABILITY IS NOT. Both facts stand; neither cancels the other.
RULING_1_max_targets_v1_is_an_UNEXECUTED.which_governs: NEITHER IS 'CORRECTED' INTO THE OTHER. The frozen metadata records what was PLANNED. The code records what was DONE. The run implements max_targets = 1 in fact, and no execution path could have produced 2 or 3.
RULING_1_max_targets_v1_is_an_UNEXECUTED.what_is_PROHIBITED: Reporting, in any write-up, that the protocol permitted up to three targets per concept. Nothing could have produced more than one, so that sentence would claim a design space the run never had. It is the same false-negative asymmetry as a gate that does not run: it reads as specified behaviour and is inert.
RULING_1_max_targets_v1_is_an_UNEXECUTED.what_is_REQUIRED: Any results document that cites the frozen prompt-set metadata must state that max_targets_v1 = 3 was pre-registered and NOT exercised, and that the executed value was 1.
RULING_1_max_targets_v1_is_an_UNEXECUTED.do_not_edit_metadata_json: It is a frozen prompt-set artifact. Post-hoc editing a pre-registration to match what the code did is the precise inversion of pre-registration. The divergence is disclosed here instead.
RULING_1_max_targets_v1_is_an_UNEXECUTED.second_target_relevance_gain_min: Equally inert, and it also presupposes a JUDGED gain -- which routes through the judging stage that the certified run does not contain. It could not have been evaluated even if a reader existed.

RULING_2_the_greedy_composer_is_a_PROPOS.the_question_asked: Is the existing composer a legitimate first stage, or does adopting it risk the set search inheriting a sufficiency claim it cannot carry?
RULING_2_the_greedy_composer_is_a_PROPOS.verdict: BOTH ARE TRUE, AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE WHOLE RULING. It is a legitimate PROPOSER of candidate sets. It may NEVER, on its own output, support a sufficiency claim.
RULING_2_the_greedy_composer_is_a_PROPOS.why_it_cannot_carry_sufficiency: steering_feature_set_definition RULING_3 requires joint intervention on the whole set in ONE forward pass AND minimality under removal. Greedy addition evaluates one feature at a time against the current partial set; it never intervenes on the final set jointly and never tests removal. A set assembled greedily is a HYPOTHESIS about which features matter together, and an untested hypothesis is not evidence.

THE_SHARPER_PROBLEM_THE_COORDINATOR_DID_.finding: GREEDY COMPOSITION DOES NOT FIX THE LOW-RECALL BIAS. IT REPRODUCES IT AT THE SET LEVEL.
THE_SHARPER_PROBLEM_THE_COORDINATOR_DID_.mechanism: Greedy addition starts from the individually-strongest feature and adds whichever feature most improves the score GIVEN what is already selected. A pair whose members are each inert alone, and which only produce an effect together, is invisible to it: neither member shows gain against the empty or near-empty set, so neither is ever admitted, so the pair is never reached.
THE_SHARPER_PROBLEM_THE_COORDINATOR_DID_.consequence: The survivor pool is high precision and low recall for FEATURES. A greedy composer over that pool is high precision and low recall for SETS. The two biases COMPOUND rather than cancel.
THE_SHARPER_PROBLEM_THE_COORDINATOR_DID_.what_this_means_for_A_9: A joint-intervention lane built on greedy proposal inherits both. That is acceptable if and only if the resulting claim is stated as bounded. It is not acceptable as a claim about which features are NEEDED, unqualified.

RULING_2_the_greedy_composer_is_a_PROPOS.additional_dependency: Greedy gain is JUDGED gain, which routes through the judging stage and therefore through the paid Lodestar path, currently unauthorised at $0 spent against a $25 cap. The composer is not free to run even once reachable.

RULING_3_the_demo_floor_is_UNDETERMINED_.the_finding: backup_trigger.json operational_targets sets demo_may_proceed_at = {shared_validated_count: 1}, and that quantity is defined POST-G-D. The certified run computes no G-D, because no judge is in its call graph.
RULING_3_the_demo_floor_is_UNDETERMINED_.verdict: A SUCCESSFUL RUN LEAVES THE DEMO FLOOR UNDETERMINED. Not met, not missed -- UNCOMPUTED.
RULING_3_the_demo_floor_is_UNDETERMINED_.this_is_not_a_defect: Judging is deliberately off-cluster because Tamia compute nodes have no outbound internet. The architecture is correct and was ratified in one_allocation_dose_generation.json. The run is not supposed to compute it.
what_is_PROHIBITED: Reporting a terminal run as having met the demo floor.
Reporting it as having MISSED the demo floor -- equally false, and the direction that unfairly understates the work.
Any status line that reads 'demo: no' without stating that the quantity was never computed.
RULING_3_the_demo_floor_is_UNDETERMINED_.what_is_REQUIRED: A terminal run reports demo_floor_status = NOT_EVALUATED, with the reason: shared_validated_count is post-G-D and no judging stage was executed.
RULING_3_the_demo_floor_is_UNDETERMINED_.how_it_becomes_determined: The off-cluster judging stage exists and is runnable (final_pairing_judge_cli.py). Running it is a separate authorization and a separate spend against the $25 cap. NOT authorized here.
RULING_3_the_demo_floor_is_UNDETERMINED_.why_this_ruling_exists: So it is not discovered at write-up. An undetermined floor found late reads as a failed run; found now it reads as a pipeline with a known next stage.

RULING_4_minimum_viable_joint_interventi.STATUS: SPECIFICATION ONLY. THIS AUTHORIZES NOTHING -- not a lane, not an allocation, not a mode change, not a config change, not a single GPU-hour or dollar.

shape.stage_1_propose: Reachable greedy composition -- --mode full with --bundle-max-size k. A mode flag and a size, not new science. Output: one CANDIDATE SET per concept. Labelled hypothesis, never result.
shape.stage_2_joint_test: Intervene on ALL k members SIMULTANEOUSLY in one forward pass. Measure delta concept_relevance against the SAME paired same-seed control the certified protocol already mandates. Passes iff it clears the G-D threshold as a set.
shape.stage_3_minimality: k leave-one-out runs per candidate set. The set is MINIMAL iff removing any single member materially degrades the effect. A set that survives stage 2 and fails stage 3 is SUFFICIENT BUT NOT MINIMAL and must be reported as such, never as 'the features needed'.

RULING_4_minimum_viable_joint_interventi.cost_shape: Per candidate set of size k: 1 joint + k leave-one-out = (k+1) generation conditions per prompt, plus judging of each. Cost is linear in k and multiplies by the concept count. At k=3 this is 4x the per-set generation of a single-feature dose point before any judging.
RULING_4_minimum_viable_joint_interventi.on_cluster_or_off: SPLIT, EXACTLY AS THE CERTIFIED PROTOCOL ALREADY SPLITS. Generation on-cluster (needs model plus SAE on GPU). Judging off-cluster (needs the Anthropic API; compute nodes have no outbound internet). The lane inherits one_allocation_dose_generation.json's architecture unchanged -- this is the cheapest correct answer and it introduces no new transfer or provenance machinery.

does_it_consume_the_survivor_pool.verdict: YES, AND THE RESULTING CLAIM IS BOUNDED BY THAT CHOICE. Legitimate, cheap, and honest only if the bound is stated.
does_it_consume_the_survivor_pool.permitted_claim: Among features that individually clear G-A/B/C, this minimal set jointly steers the concept.
does_it_consume_the_survivor_pool.PROHIBITED_claim: These are the features needed to steer the concept. The pool cannot support an unqualified claim because features that matter only jointly never enter it.
does_it_consume_the_survivor_pool.what_would_lift_the_bound: Evidence that jointly-only features are rare on this corpus rather than merely possible -- measurable, and a legitimate object of the read-only investigation. Absent that, the caveat is load-bearing and may not be dropped.

what_the_run_DOES_deliver.$comment: Recorded so that none of the above is read as dismissal.
delivered: 14 concept verdicts per pairing with per-family separation, fire-rate and near-miss evidence
one gate-passing feature index per passing concept
dose-response and full-ablation generations with paired same-seed controls
what_the_run_DOES_deliver.assessment: Real and non-trivial. It is the RAW MATERIAL for a steering claim rather than the steering claim.

hard_stops: Reporting that the protocol permitted up to three targets per concept.
Reporting a terminal run as having met OR missed the demo floor; it is NOT_EVALUATED.
Presenting a greedily-composed set as evidence of sufficiency.
Claiming a set is 'the features needed' without both a minimality test and the survivor-pool recall caveat.
Editing prompts/final_pairing/v1/metadata.json to reconcile the pre-registration with what executed.
Treating this specification as authorization for a lane, an allocation, a mode change, or any spend.
